question:
Select the correct active form.

"Was the novel written by her?"
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence becomes the object of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Was the novel written by her?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "she" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was written" to its active form "did write" (past simple active).
 
• Ensure the object "the novel" follows the verb, maintaining proper sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Did she write the novel?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Was she writing the novel?" – Incorrect tense (past continuous active).
 
• **Option 2: **"Is she writing the novel?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous active).
 
• **Option 4: **"Has she written the novel?" – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).
